experiments.title: B02/F05 lifecycle A-B-C structural exit evaluation
experiments.mechanism: separate entry failure, post-profit collapse and delayed termination states
experiments.primary_endpoint: four-fold portfolio delta under default and severe costs
experiments.falsification_rule: reject candidates that fail required fold, cost, direction or winner-retention gates
experiments.decision: no lifecycle candidate passed the full common gate

experiments.title: F05 failed reclaim structural termination
experiments.mechanism: breakout recovers after initial re-entry but subsequently fails to remain established
experiments.primary_endpoint: historical four-fold binding portfolio delta plus raw-Tick external-period evaluation
experiments.falsification_rule: reject on technical reproduction mismatch or failure of any frozen historical or external-period gate
experiments.decision: PASS_RESEARCH_HISTORICAL_GATES for 2023H1-2024H2; 2025H1/H2 M1/HST zero detections are invalid as efficacy evidence because 2025 raw Bid/Ask Tick data were unavailable; collect 2025 Tick data and rerun failed reclaim before external-period judgment

experiments.title: B02/F05 all-loss structural SL atlas
experiments.mechanism: map executable structural failure points across the complete loss population
experiments.primary_endpoint: loss reduction versus winner damage across folds
experiments.falsification_rule: reject structures without fold breadth, cost robustness or chronology validity
experiments.decision: ATLAS_COMPLETE_NO_ROBUST_FAMILY; no additional common, B02-only or F05-only structural stop family authorized
